item.title: Physical Penetration Testing: When Physical Access Became Network Access
item.description: A Sophos physical penetration test shows how public information, badge weaknesses, workplace trust, and internal control gaps can combine into a path from the front door to the network.

item.title: Introducing the new Sophos NDR
item.description: Sophos NDR brings behavioral detection and active prevention together to identify known and unknown threats across the AI-era network.

item.title: Empowering Employees to Make a Difference: The Digital Café
item.description: The Digital Café helps people in the Nauheim community build confidence with technology, stay independent and remain connected with friends and family. Supported by Sophos’ 40 hours of paid volunteering leave, the initiative has grown into a team of volunteers making a meaningful difference through digital inclusion.

item.title: No Straight Lines: The value of a different career journey
item.description: There’s no single path to a successful career. Career changes, breaks and experience in different industries can build valuable qualities such as resilience, curiosity and perspective. By creating supportive communities, offering encouragement and recognising transferable skills, we can help people see their potential and build confidence. Embracing different career journeys ultimately brings new perspectives to technology and helps create stronger, more inclusive teams.

item.title: Making time to make a difference
item.description: At Sophos, making an impact goes beyond the work we do every day. Through up to 40 hours of annual volunteering leave, employees have dedicated time to support their communities, build stronger connections with colleagues and contribute to something bigger.

item.title: Cooking with purpose: Giving our time to support families
item.description: Sophos employees in Australia put their time and teamwork into action by volunteering with Ronald McDonald House to prepare comforting meals for families facing incredibly difficult circumstances. It’s a great example of how Sophos’s 40 hours of annual volunteering leave enables employees to make a meaningful difference in their communities.
